user.title: GWM China
user.description: Enter the phone number registered in the Tank app. A dedicated account is strongly recommended (do not reuse the account logged in on your phone).

sms.title: SMS verification code
sms.description: A code was sent to {phone}. Enter it within a few minutes.

vehicle.title: Select vehicle
vehicle.description: Multiple vehicles are bound to this account. Select the one to add.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again to GWM China
reauth_confirm.description: The login has expired (token lifetime ended, or the account was signed in elsewhere). A new SMS code will be sent to {phone}.

error.invalid_phone: Invalid phone number (11 digits starting with 1)
error.risk_control: Risk control triggered: sign in once with this account in the official Tank app, then try again
error.code_rejected: Verification code is wrong or expired. Request a new one.
error.no_vehicles: No vehicles bound to this account
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the GWM server. Try again later.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for a traceback (search for gwm_cn).

init.title: GWM China options
init.description: Polling interval and remote control toggle. Remote control can start the engine — park somewhere safe and ventilated.

data.enable_remote: Enable remote control (lock/climate/engine start — real vehicle commands)

error.invalid_interval: Interval must be between 30 and 3600 seconds
